title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of How to Apply the Law in Disputes over Compensation for a Transportation Contract Caused by the Loss of Insured Goods

articles.content_en:
Reply of the Supreme People's Court
Regarding the contract of carriage disputes arising from loss of insured cargo
Reply on the issue of how to apply the law to compensation disputes
Fa (Jiao) Fu [1989] No. 3
Higher People's Court of Liaoning Province:
We have received your letter Liao Fa (Jing) Qing [1988] No. 127. Upon study and after soliciting opinions from relevant departments, we reply as follows:
For cargo that has been insured under cargo transportation insurance, if loss is caused due to the carrier's liability, the carrier shall compensate according to the actual loss of the cargo in accordance with Article 41 of the Economic Contract Law of the People's Republic of China. If the insurance company makes advance compensation in accordance with the insurance contract, the carrier shall compensate the difference between the insurance compensation and the actual loss due to insufficient insured amount.
May 30, 1989
